note: An [[errata.column]] entry beside an [[errata.delivered]] entry for one literal (#1647). Register TEST (1, variant 2) has editions 2018, 2020, 2020-06-30 (a sub-annual edition inside 2020) and 2022; Q (var 5) and R (var 6) are documented only in 2018. Both columns are delivered in 2020 by a delivered entry. The R column entry names 2022, a period nothing documents or delivers R in, so it mints its own c-r variable with one 2022 state beside v6's 2018 and 2020 states. The Q column entry names 2020-06-30: a different edition name from the delivered 2020, but a date inside it, so the two variables would both claim Q on that date; it is refused as column_now_documented and forms no c-q state, while v5 keeps its documented 2018 and delivered 2020 states. The R column entry authors measurement_unit "Antal" (#1665): the c-r state and variable carry it, while v6's documented and delivered states, which state and author no unit, have none.
fails_if: `scb_errata.convert_column_entry` compares only edition names with the delivered entry's versions (c-q built on 2020-06-30), or refuses every column entry beside a delivered one (no c-r state); or `[[errata.column]]` takes no `measurement_unit` or the mint drops it (c-r has no unit)

sources.description: Editions 2018, 2020, 2020-06-30 and 2022; Q and R documented only in 2018.
